Subject: MAP draft and execution dependencies - proposed procurement deadline

Carlos — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a short SOW outline for your procurement and legal teams to review. Key points and proposed milestones below (please confirm owners and dates):

- Target close (contract signed): 2026-11-30 (proposed)
- Procurement signature deadline (internal vendor signoff): 2026-11-09
- Security review completion (Vendor security & SOC2): 2026-10-22
- Legal redlines complete: 2026-11-03
- Integration POC kickoff (technical): 2026-12-07

Milestone owners (proposed):
- Procurement / signature logistics: Vertex procurement (Carlos)
- Legal review and redlines: Vertex legal + Redwood legal (Rishi will own Redwood side)
- Security artifacts / evidence: Redwood Security (we will provide SOC2 letter + network diagram)
- POC scope and resources: Monica (AE/technical lead)

Dependencies we flagged on the call:
- Vertex requires supplier questionnaire and completed security checklist before legal signs off
- Procurement needs an approved SOW and SOW cost estimate to raise the PO

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm whether the procurement signature deadline above is feasible for Vertex procurement.
2) Share any absolute immovable dates from procurement/legal that would force an earlier close.
3) I will circulate an updated MAP (v1.1) with dates adjusted and assign owners formally.

Attachments: MAP_draft_20260914.pdf, SOW_outline_v0.3.docx

If helpful, we can do a 30-min alignment call with procurement + legal this week — what times work for you?

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop

Thanks Lauren — good recap and appreciate the attachments. Quick notes from procurement/legal side after I checked internal calendars: 

- Procurement has a monthly contract window; to get on the November signing run we need final vendor packet + SOW by 2026-10-20. That means the vendor security review must land no later than 2026-10-20.
- Legal requires at least 8 business days for redlines once they receive the final draft; given our internal holidays, I recommend aiming for signature no later than 2026-11-01 if we meet those precursor dates.

So: can Redwood commit to delivering the security artifacts and final SOW by 2026-10-18? If yes, procurement will target a vendor signature date of 2026-11-01. I will attach a procurement timeline spreadsheet for our internal flow.

Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx

If you can move the MAP's procurement signature deadline forward to 2026-11-01 (instead of 11/09) we can lock this into the November run. Happy to jump on the alignment call as well — this Thurs 10/15 or Fri 10/16 works best for our team.

—Carlos
Carlos Ruiz
Director, Procurement Operations | Vertex Health
